meta.title: jQuery Schedule Plugin - DOM Element Caching Optimization
meta.body_summary: Implement DOM element caching and loop optimizations in jQuery Schedule plugin to reduce DOM queries and improve drag/drop performance, with an efficiency analysis report.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added DOM caching and loop fixes with an efficiency report; no human review, PR auto-closed after ~8 days of inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 190 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. The PR was closed without merge due to complete lack of maintainer engagement, consistent with a process boundary for agent PRs in low-activity repositories.

review_details.concern_detail: No maintainer review or feedback was provided; the only interactions were Devin bot auto-replies and auto-close after 7+ days of inactivity.
review_details.performance_claim: 20-30% reduction in DOM query operations, improved responsiveness during drag/drop, and better performance with large numbers of schedule items.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: repeated_io (uncached DOM queries) and inefficient_loop (for...in on arrays)
review_details.rejection_signals: Auto-closed by Devin bot after more than 7 days without any human review or comment.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A small frontend DOM caching PR in a low-traffic jQuery plugin repository was completely ignored by maintainers, demonstrating that AI agent PRs can be stalled by lack of human attention even when scoped correctly.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Only narrative claims and a self-reported manual test by the Devin bot; no benchmark, profiler, or CI validation, and no maintainer verification.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed automatically due to inactivity; no regression fix cycle took place.

core_change_summary.description: Cached frequently accessed DOM elements (timeline, bars, container) in multiple jQuery methods and converted for...in loops on arrays to standard for loops; added EFFICIENCY_REPORT.md with analysis of performance bottlenecks.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Built distribution files were updated as part of the optimization change.
change_trajectory: Single commit with all DOM caching modifications, loop fixes, efficiency report, and dist rebuild.

review_signals.summary: Devin bot announced automatic comment/CI assistance for write-access users.
Closing due to inactivity for more than 7 days.
